name: Shairport
description: Manages the Shairport AirPlay receiver app (com.hkfuertes.shairport) on this kiosk: its settings from Kiosk Satellite, its state and current track as Home Assistant entities. It does not run the receiver itself. Requires the Shairport app and Shizuku access for Kiosk Satellite.
author: hkfuertes

settings.title: AirPlay receiver
settings.description: Starts or stops Shairport Sync and its AirPlay advertisement.

settings.title: AirPlay 2 (multi-room)
settings.description: Needs root: Magisk may ask on this device. Off: classic AirPlay.

settings.title: Name
settings.description: Name shown in the AirPlay list. Empty: the Android device name.

settings.title: Model
settings.description: Advertised model: the icon senders show. AirPlay 2 only; classic AirPlay is Generic. HomePod models can't be added to the Home app.

settings.title: Start at boot
settings.description: Starts the receiver after every reboot.
